digests.body:
## Confirmed submissions

- **IXL Learning — Software Engineer, New Grad: submitted** with ML__7 after the posting was re-verified live on IXL's own careers page (the sheet's job ID was dead; the same role was live under a corrected ID).
- **Five Honor Society applications submitted — $8,000 in total:** Graduate Student Achiever ($2,000), Emerging Leaders ($1,000), High Honors ($2,000), Lone Star Texas ($2,000) and John Young "Pursue Your Passion" ($1,000). Recipients are notified within 14 days of each deadline.

## Screening results

- The **Backdoor sponsorship sheet** was screened end to end: 38 companies checked on official boards. No Summer 2027 internships exist at any of them, and there is no product role that is a clean verified fit — the strongest PM match, IXL Associate PM New Grad (8.7), stays blocked by its mandatory cover letter.
- **Two NVIDIA Category A flags** for manual filing: JR2028260 (Agentic Systems) and JR2027548 (LLM/Multimodal), both 8.5 vs ML__6 and live tonight.

## Needs you

- **Formlabs** is parked on one question — the project you are most proud of, and why. The open form tab expires about 00:56 CT tonight.
- **BVCC Session 9** is tomorrow, Tue Nov 10, 18:00–20:00 CT. The Advanced Programmes interview update expected today has still not arrived.
